faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Can't find your answer? Contact us or ask The IDEA Droid on Telegram.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Browse the store, add items to your cart and check out. You need The IDEA Pass to order; signing up takes a minute.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Payments are processed securely by Wayl, which supports local payment methods. Your order is confirmed once the payment succeeds.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: We deliver to all 19 governorates of Iraq. The delivery fee, if any, is shown at checkout before you pay.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, under the conditions in our refund and returns policy. Contact us from your order in Your Pass or by email.

items.question: How does The IDEA Plus work?
items.answer: You subscribe to a monthly plan. Each plan lets you keep a number of items at a time. Request a game, book or movie, we deliver it, and when you're done you return it and request the next one.

items.question: Can I buy from the store without a membership?
items.answer: Absolutely. The store is open to everyone; The IDEA Plus is only needed for rentals.

items.question: How do I cancel?
items.answer: You can cancel your membership from Your Pass. It stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Please return any rented items.

items.question: Do I need to sign up separately for each service?
items.answer: No. One The IDEA Pass works across the store, The IDEA Plus, The IDEA Club and The IDEA Business.

items.question: How do I delete The IDEA Pass?
items.answer: You can delete it from the settings in Your Pass. Some records, such as invoices, are kept as the law requires.

items.question: How do I get help with an order or a rental?
items.answer: Sign in and open a support ticket from Help. You can follow our replies there. Without The IDEA Pass, email hi@theideaiq.com or use the contact form.

developers.description: Let people sign in to your website or app with their The IDEA Pass, and learn only what they allow: their name, email, whether they're a verified student, 18 or over, a The IDEA Plus member, and more.

steps.domain: Verify your domain with a DNS record or a file.
steps.app: Register your app: you get a client id and a secret (shown once).
steps.test: Test it: while in testing, only your company's members can sign in.
steps.live: Go live. The basic answers work at once; we review the sensitive ones within two working days.

guide.title: For your developers
guide.flow: It's standard OpenID Connect: the authorization code flow with PKCE (S256). Send people to the authorization address from the discovery document; they come back to your return address with a code, which your server exchanges at the token endpoint.
guide.auth: Your server authenticates with the client secret (HTTP Basic or form fields) or, with keys below, a signed client assertion (private_key_jwt, ES256 or RS256, at most 5 minutes, a new jti each time). Never put the secret in a browser or a mobile app.
guide.scopes: Ask for openid plus the answers your app is registered for. People can untick any of them; the token response's scope lists what they shared. Each person has a different sub at each app.
guide.card: With the card answer, your server can fetch the person's card image (GET /oidc/card). To check a scanned Pass card at a door, POST its code to /oidc/card/check with your credentials.
guide.keys: After a new secret, the previous one keeps working for 24 hours so you can switch without downtime, unless you stop it.

developers.once: Copy these now: the secret isn't shown again. Keep it on your server only.
